import csv
import io
from decimal import Decimal
from api import order_summary
from csv_export import render_order

cases = [
    ({'id': 17, 'total': Decimal('12.3'), 'currency': 'USD'}, '12.30'),
    ({'id': 'order,\"quoted\"\\nnext', 'total': Decimal('12345678901234567890.12'), 'currency': 'U,\"S\"\\nD'}, '12345678901234567890.12'),
    ({'id': 0, 'total': Decimal('0'), 'currency': 'JPY'}, '0.00'),
    ({'id': 18, 'total': Decimal('-1.236'), 'currency': 'EUR'}, '-1.24'),
]
for order, total in cases:
    assert order_summary(order) == {'id': order['id'], 'total': total, 'currency': order['currency']}
    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(render_order(order)))) == [
        ['id', 'total', 'currency'],
        [str(order['id']), total, order['currency']],
    ]
assert render_order(cases[0][0]) == 'id,total,currency\\r\\n17,12.30,USD\\r\\n'
print('Passed 4 API/CSV cases: currency, decimal formatting, CSV escaping, and exactly one order record.')
PY
